findings.text: source_domains is still a parameter of persist_refined_name and is now dead: no statement binds it and nothing reads it, so a caller that passes it (worker_tasks/worker_refine_names.py:733) has its source-domain set silently discarded instead of refused, when the writer recomputes source domains from the migrated sources; remove the parameter and its caller argument so the drop is visible in the signature rather than in the lost value.

The successor's domain write runs after tx.commit() and outside the transaction, so a failure inside write_name_domain leaves a committed successor with no physics_domain -- the half-written rename the capability check was moved up to prevent, still reachable through the writer's own failure; the successor row for write_name_domain to find is the reason the transaction has to commit first, so the residue is a design tradeoff worth naming rather than a site to change here.

This path is changed by 203a79c84 (its two HAS_PHYSICS_DOMAIN edge assertions are inverted) and is not in the reviewed run's live node.write_paths, so the landed diff writes outside the recorded fence; the worker discloses the gap at manifest.md:26 and the coordinator must add this path to node.write_paths before the node lands, or the promotion check will read the commit as out-of-scope.

The fragment calls graph_claim_scope.py 'filters and projections only ... No write, no change', but graph_claim_scope.py:845 writes physics_domain onto StandardNameSource nodes (from src.physics_domain at :845 and from the name's own scalar at :820); the brief asks that html say which sites write a domain on a node other than a StandardName, so the entry understates the module's writes and should name the StandardNameSource field.

The base arm's '# module' header names the head worktree's graph_catalog.py, not the base tree, so the log read literally claims base tests ran against head source; the opposite is the case here (base-only test_physics_domain_uses_coalesce passes, which head source would redden), but the evidence does not state what was imported and a later reader cannot distinguish the two before running that check.

The new _answer_domain_state helper is copy-pasted into seven test files (test_atomic_refined_name_persistence.py, test_minted_name_carries_a_catalog_status.py, test_persist_stages.py, test_refine_name_chain.py, test_snrun_async_counters.py, test_supersession.py, test_edit_engine.py) when this module already owns the same state row builder at _row :38; lift it to tests/standard_names/conftest.py so an eighth copy does not rediscover the writer's read a fourth way.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: 78a2bbd50 deletes the promote block, b2e3d7753/de609213c route the rename's successor through the writer and replace the isinstance gate with a capability check, 203a79c84/d5ac1a5a6 rewrite the catalog invariants, a436958fd answers the writer's state read in the mock clients, and 60e1cf54d moves the capability check above the transaction; 1fc6d22f2 is docs-only (fragment).
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for per-path disposable-graph tests that fail on revert, and zero added failure ids against main; four such tests exist and two negative controls show the relights (logs/negative-control.log, logs/negative-control-isinstance.log), and both marker sets are recorded with readable base and evidence; the recovery of the earlier unreadable default-marker arm is confirmed by the EXIT=1 and summary line of logs/gate-head-default-final.log.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to route the catalog-side graph-store domain writes through write_name_domain; graph_catalog.py:487-497 now withholds the domain pair from the structural pass and the promote SET is deleted, graph_refinement.py:1385-1421 routes the successor's domain through the writer, and the derived-parent writers named by the brief are outside the module fence, recorded as a gap at manifest.md:25.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the final gate arms with their logs and EXIT lines (manifest.md:19-22), the negative control at logs/negative-control-isinstance.log with EXIT=1 (manifest.md:17-18), the retried fixtures under retry_failures/retry_failures with attribution to the mock fixtures rather than code under test (manifest.md:9), and the one remaining record blocker at manifest.md:26.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The live record grants 17 paths; the diff touches 15, of which tests/standard_names/test_graph_edge_writers.py is not granted (manifest.md:26 says so), and the other nine extra test files are granted by the review thread although the delivered brief listed seven paths.

justifications.durability: Each routed path has a disposable-graph test whose assertion is a post-write graph read (test_name_domain_writer_catalog_sites.py:121-127, :290-296), not a restatement of its input, and the two mutations recorded at negative-control.log and negative-control-isinstance.log each darken the intended id; the rewritten invariant at test_metadata_invariants.py:163-211 asserts the absence of the physics_domain/source_domains/HAS_PHYSICS_DOMAIN tokens, which a reintroduced SET reddens, and both mutations are shown doing so at logs/negative-control-no-domain-set.log and logs/negative-control-domain-edge-feed.log.
justifications.evidence: The gate logs are readable receipts: gate-head-default-final.log ends '71 failed, 8412 passed, 11 skipped' + EXIT=1 and gate-base-default.log '73 failed, 8409 passed, 11 skipped' + EXIT=1, and recomputing set(after)-set(base) from the manifest's own baseline_suite/after_suite yields no added id on either arm; the base logs' line-3 '# module' names the head worktree rather than the base tree, so the base arm's source is inferable (its base-only test test_physics_domain_uses_coalesce passes, which head source would fail) but is not stated.
justifications.fit: The change follows the surrounding idiom and its naming, but persist_refined_name still accepts source_domains (graph_refinement.py:693) and silently ignores it, so a caller at worker_tasks/worker_refinement.py:733 hands over a set that no longer reaches the graph and gets no signal that it was dropped.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both StandardName domain sites in the fenced modules are routed or deleted: graph_catalog.py:346-434 (promote block, now deleted) and graph_refinement.py:1414 (_dd.write_name_domain carries the predecessor's stored decision with fallback_domain), and graph_claim_scope/graph_audits carried only reads, so every StandardName domain write the node could reach now goes through the one writer.
justifications.reuse: The production addition extends the existing owner rather than forking it (fallback_domain added to domain_decision.write_name_domain at :413), but the new test helper _answer_domain_state is pasted into seven files when tests/standard_names/test_domain_decision.py:38 already owns a state-row builder (_row) that answers the same read.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the 15-file diff is inside node.write_paths except tests/standard_names/test_graph_edge_writers.py, which the live record omits (the worker lists it in its own orientation and discloses the omission at manifest.md:26); the remaining 14 changed paths are the ten granted tests plus the three code/fragment paths.
